name: BRR DSP
description: 16-bit era 4-bit BRR ADPCM codec (F0-F3 predictors), 4-point Gaussian interpolator, 4-32 kHz voice clock, and 4 output models.

params.name: Model
params.explanation: SNES hardware stage (WARM = vintage warm stage, CLEAN = crisp revision, RAW = direct S-DSP digital, ZOH = bypass Gaussian).

params.name: Filter
params.explanation: SNES 4-bit BRR ADPCM predictor filter (F0=Direct, F1=15/16, F2=61/32-15/16, F3=115/64-13/16).

params.name: Rate
params.explanation: BRR voice sample rate into the 32 kHz S-DSP Gaussian interpolator (4..32 kHz).

params.name: Gauss
params.explanation: SNES 4-point Gaussian interpolator warmth / blanket rolloff (0 = crisp linear/ZOH, 75 = authentic SNES, 100 = extra cloudy).

params.name: BrrGrit
params.explanation: 4-bit BRR ADPCM compression & adaptive nibble quantization grit (0 = clean 16-bit, 55 = authentic BRR, 100 = crushed).

params.name: Drive
params.explanation: Pre-BRR input overdrive with S-DSP 16-bit saturation (0..100).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Master output level (80 is unity gain).
